text:
maria: Short sync — we're crafting a compact benchmark narrative for launch: 1 blog post, 3 reproducible charts, a 30-min webinar, and inbound routing so AEs only get high-intent leads. Need quick takes on chart designs, 3 hook directions, and routing signals.

sam: For hooks: (1) token dollars (USD / 1k tokens for chat & summarization), (2) tail risk (p50 vs p99 under load), (3) throughput economics (responses / $ at common batch sizes). Hero chart should be readable at a glance.

tess: Webinar structure: 8m findings, 12m live demo (copy-paste eval kit + toggles for batching/cache/quant), 10m Q&A + CTA. Demo must include exact commands and link to the repo.

leo: Routing rules to prioritize: downloaded_pdf -> AE+SE; clicked_dedicated OR requested_run_slice -> AE outreach; webinar_attendee AND company_size>=150 -> AE outreach. Otherwise, nurture drip with quickstart. Add "primary_use_case" on form (chat/search/summarize/code).

zach: Microcopy candidates for A/B: A) "Benchmark your slice in 10 minutes" B) "See token dollars and latency for your app" C) "Keep latency, cut cost — run a quick eval". Recommend A for top-of-funnel, C for modal.

maria: Chart specs (minimal):
- hero_econ_line: x = cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, y = median_latency_ms, series = [redwood_opt, baseline]. Callouts: chat_512, long_2048.
- tail_latency_area: x = percentile, y = latency_ms, series = [redwood, competitor], annotate p95/p99 gaps.
- batch_cost_bar: x = batch_size, y = cost_per_1000_responses, overlay median_latency_line, series = [1,8,32].
Include a short methodology caption under each chart (hardware, prompt length, model family). Link to eval scripts.

sam: Tone and claims: use conditional language. Eg "In our testbed, batch+cache reduced per-response cost up to 4x; many slices see 1.5x-2.5x improvements." Put full methodology in the PDF footer.

tess: I'll draft the demo runbook and the 30s slide rundown. Keep the demo commands first, then short explanation.

leo: I'll ship a routing JSON sample and the product event mapping by tomorrow morning. We'll map signals to CRM priority flags.

zach: I'll implement microcopy A/B in the signup modal and capture CTR -> signup -> run-slice conversion.

maria: Action items + owners (deadline: draft by Thu EOD): sam -> blog lead + chart SVG mocks; tess -> demo scripts + run-of-show; leo -> routing JSON; zach -> microcopy tests; maria -> one-pager PDF outline + slide deck.

ops-bot: Webinar created: https://cal.link/redwood-bench-mini — slots Tue 11am / Wed 3pm / Thu 10am.

maria: Great. Keep claims conservative, charts reproducible, and routing strict so AEs only see warm leads. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
